lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sm8Ga4Pb4 (reduced formula Sm2GaPb) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imm2 (No. 143), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga centers with a tetrahedral environment of four Sm neighbors, while Pb centers have 14 geometric neighbors (4 Ga, 10 Sm). The neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ga tetrahedra and corner-sharing between Ga tetrahedra and Sm 9-vertex coordination polyhedra.
